request: Show each order with the employee responsible for it.
search_document:
User Request: Show each order with the employee responsible for it.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Orders Overview
Type: table
Description: List of orders with associated employee responsible
Title: Employee Performance
Type: chart
Description: Performance metrics of employees based on orders handled

sql_queries.title: Orders Overview
sql_queries.description: List of orders with associated employee responsible
sql_queries.sql: SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, o.ShipName, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID

sql_queries.title: Employee Performance
sql_queries.description: Performance metrics of employees based on orders handled
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS OrdersHandled FROM Employees e LEFT JOIN Orders o ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID, e.FirstName, e.LastName
